subject: [Action] IR handoff: sanitized postmortem & accountability list
messages:
From: Sara Martin <sara.martin@finprotocol.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finprotocol.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: brief incident notify + ask for sanitized postmortem

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick update this morning. Per our SOC 2 audit window and internal compliance team ask, we need a sanitized postmortem and a short accountability list (who did what, owner for each corrective action) as evidence by Friday 11/13.

Specifically we need:
- a one-page executive summary of the incident and containment timeline (sanitized for customer PII)
- a spreadsheet with corrective actions, owners, and dates
- exported telemetry slices for 2026-10-29 through 2026-11-02 showing the anomalous request signatures (CSV stub is fine)

Can you confirm Redwood can provide these artifacts and a point of contact for any quick follow-up questions from our audit team? We will treat the materials as confidential.

--
Sara Martin
Sr. Security Operations Manager
FinProtocol Inc.

[Attachment: initial-notify-summary.txt (text)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Martin <sara.martin@finprotocol.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: brief incident notify + ask for sanitized postmortem

Sara — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested artifacts.

Planned deliverables (target: 11/13 EOD PST):
- Sanitized postmortem PDF (exec summary + timeline + root cause narrative).
- Accountability spreadsheet: owner, action, target date, status (XLSX).
- Telemetry export (CSV) with minimal fields: timestamp, request_id (redacted), event_type, latencies.

Point of contact: Neha Kapoor (cc’d) will own evidence delivery and follow-ups. Jonas will validate that the telemetry slice is redacted per your PII constraints and Karthik will verify IR action items and owners.

A couple of quick asks so we scope correctly:
1) For telemetry, do you want full request hashes or just request_id placeholders? (we prefer placeholders/redacted)
2) Any specific format your auditors prefer for the accountability sheet? (we can provide CSV or XLSX)

We will upload an interim artifact bundle to a shared Drive link and send a final packet with a signed cover letter.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

[Signature]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: evidence bundle draft and redaction checklist

Team — quick internal note while I assemble the artifacts for FinProtocol:

Attachments (draft): telemetry-export-20261029-20261102.csv (partial), accountability-actions-draft.xlsx, sanitized-postmortem-draft.docx

Redaction checklist applied:
- Replace customer identifiers with hashed placeholders (REQ_ID_xxx)
- Remove IPs tied to customer endpoints
- Remove any verbatim customer data in logs and stack traces
- Validate timestamps are in UTC and labeled in the CSV

Jonas — please confirm the telemetry export has the reduced column set we agreed earlier (timestamp, event_type, req_placeholder, latency_ms). If OK I will convert to CSV and mark as "evidence" for delivery.
Karthik — please review the actions sheet and assign owners for the 7 corrective items; I put initial suggestions in column B.

I am attaching the Drive folder link where I'm dropping the drafts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-sanitized-postmortem

Neha
Sr. Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Martin <sara.martin@finprotocol.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Deliverable: sanitized postmortem + accountability packet (JIRA-OPS-9123)

Sara — attached is our final evidence packet for your audit window. Thank you for the patience while we completed the redaction pass.

Delivered artifacts (attached + Drive):
- sanitized-postmortem.pdf (PDF, 5 pages) — exec summary, timeline, root cause, remediation, and regression testing plan.
- ir-accountability-actions.xlsx (XLSX) — seven actions, owners, expected completion dates.
- telemetry-summary-exports.csv (CSV) — redacted placeholders for request ids.

Summary highlights:
- Containment completed: 2026-10-30 04:22 UTC.
- Root cause: misconfigured cache invalidation policy plus an edge-case in our routing layer that exposed stale response headers under a narrow request signature.
- Immediate fix: configuration rollback + hotfix deployed 2026-10-30 06:10 UTC.
- Longer-term actions: rule-based validation for cache rules, additional preflight checks in the compilation pipeline, and a new quorum check for routing decisions (see actions sheet).

We redacted any fields that could be used to correlate to specific customers per your guidance. If your auditors need deeper telemetry slices, please request them via the secure intake form so we can apply the appropriate NDAs and redaction controls.

Next steps:
- Neha will be available for direct auditor questions (neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com).
- We will update JIRA-OPS-9123 with progress and expected completion dates for each corrective action.

Thanks again — reach out if you need clarifications.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: sanitized-postmortem.pdf (PDF), ir-accountability-actions.xlsx (XLSX), telemetry-summary-exports.csv (CSV)]
